scope: Operation-scoped funding receipt verification with native transport ownership and local identity fences.
reasoning: Full network/account attestation brackets funding verification; per-read guard still checks session owner, captured deployment/network, trusted node, wallet/PXE route and caller context. Other full guards remain unchanged.

Only exact saved transaction/receipt hash and code at saved receipt height are memoized inside one invocation. Canonical L1 block, finalized anchor and L2 header/witness checks are not cached. Fresh post-witness rechecks still reject reorgs.
All exact intent/calldata/account/portal/effect/custody/secret/message-root checks remain; returned claim is not a payment or submit authority. Original journal and no-replay fences unchanged.

Whole-operation20second Promise.race removed; reads are awaited and transport failures retain UNKNOWN classification. This eliminates abandoned in-flight verification work and cumulative deadline failures without manufacturing progress.
Cache is discarded between invocations, including prepare versus submit revalidation. Tests preserve actual adversarial mismatch and canonical reorg expectations rather than duplicate-read counts.
limits: Existing tests use labelled provider/component doubles and real encoding/hash/witness logic, not fresh public-network proofs.
No claim that the actual paid wallet continuation succeeded until the affected deployed path is observed.
Provider request failure bounds remain transport-owned; this patch adds no polling scheduler or timeout-driven fallback.
